videos.titleEn: How are microchips made? Episode 6 | ASML Nanoland
videos.originalTitle: How are microchips made? Episode 6 | ASML Nanoland
videos.author: ASML
videos.captionNote: 字幕與自動翻譯依原平台提供，未保證完整繁體中文字幕。
videos.captionNoteEn: Captions and automatic translations depend on the original platform; complete Traditional Chinese captions are not guaranteed.
videos.scope: 本課「極紫外金屬氧化物光阻研究」的延伸背景。以製造全貌辨認沉積、微影與蝕刻如何反覆建立不同層。 影片並非本課每一道步驟的實拍。
videos.scopeEn: Related background for EUV metal-oxide resist research. Identify how repeated deposition, lithography and etching construct different layers. It is not footage of every step in this course.
watchFor: 辨認晶圓、晶粒和電晶體的不同尺度。
找出微影形成光阻圖案與蝕刻轉移圖案的差別。
記下影片簡化或省略的量測、清洗與重複工序。
watchForEn: Distinguish wafer, die and transistor scales.
Separate resist pattern formation from pattern transfer by etching.
Note metrology, cleaning and repeated operations simplified or omitted in the animation.
videos.before: 先問：「畫出光子到溶解度的因果鏈」需要哪種材料或介面證據？畫出本課與影片案例的共同處及不同處。
videos.beforeEn: Ask what material or interface evidence Trace photons to changed solubility requires. Draw the common ground and differences between this course and the video case.
videos.after: 把「設計劑量與焦距的二維矩陣」列為查證任務：最佳單點不等於具有寬製程窗口。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
videos.afterEn: Follow-up evidence task for Design a dose–focus matrix: An optimum point is not a broad process window. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

courses.summary: 極紫外金屬氧化物光阻研究涉及跨國材料、設備與量測合作。本課程地圖選用imec 魯汶研究園區（Tower 代表點）作為公開研究或設備技術的代表位置。課程練習以公開原理連結圖形、材料與驗證，不宣稱此處為唯一發明地、所有技術的生產工廠或實際機台位置。
courses.summaryEn: EUV metal-oxide resist research involves international collaboration in materials, equipment and metrology. The map uses imec Leuven research campus: Tower reference as a public research or equipment-technology reference. Exercises connect patterns, materials and validation through public principles; this is not claimed to be the sole invention site, a factory producing every technology, or an instrument location.

history.title: 公開混合圖案化整合案例
history.text: imec 說明 SAQP 與 EUV 阻擋圖案化如何共同服務金屬層整合。這是產業研發沿革，不表示本課程全部技術於當年或此地發明。
history.textEn: imec described combining SAQP and EUV block patterning for metal-layer integration. This is research history, not a claim that every course technology was invented there or then.

courses.connection: 比較相關課程時，逐項追蹤材料、圖案形成方式、誤差與驗收證據的差異；相似原理不表示配方可直接移植。
courses.connectionEn: Compare related courses by materials, pattern formation, errors and acceptance evidence. Similar principles do not make recipes directly transferable.
